caption:
Swipe through, grab each prompt, and paste it into Claude Code tonight: five tools your competitors pay hundreds a month for, built free in plain English. 🛠️

In order: a competitor price tracker that emails you the moment any rival changes their pricing, a Gmail auto-responder that reads new inquiries and sends the right reply within minutes, an invoice generator that reads your client spreadsheet and emails every PDF automatically, a booking page that syncs with Google Calendar at no monthly cost, and a morning briefing that pulls yesterday's Shopify revenue, email open rates, and ad spend into one clean summary before you wake up.

Anthropic ends its Cursor partnership on November 12, after SpaceX acquired the coding tool. Claude Code is the direct path now: type what you want in plain English and it builds the whole thing. Every tool in this post costs $200 to $1,500 a month somewhere. Running a business? DM us "AI" and we'll show you what this looks like for yours.
